text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong and how likely it is to happen. Next, you need mitigation strategies to reduce the impact of these risks. For example, you can train staff or buy insurance. It is also important to have contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if a problem actually occurs. Finally, monitoring means checking risks regularly and updating your plans when things change. Good risk management helps organisations avoid serious problems and reach their goals more safely.
